item.title: 19 Aug — UKGC swings; EWC schedule locks in
item.description: What changed for us - UK: UKGC fined Holland Park Leisure Ltd £150,000 and ordered a third‑party audit for failing to join the mandatory multi‑operator self‑exclusion scheme. The licence had been suspended back in Oct 2025; the fine lands today (Aug 18). Why it matters: self‑exclusion and scheme‑integration failures are drawing swift penalties; our UK/GB feeds, venue routing, and retail‑adjacent …
